name: Grand Prix Cycliste de Montréal
story: Nine riders formed the early breakaway, but they were caught before the halfway point. Repeated attacks forced numerous riders to lose contact with the peloton, while Ben Healy rode solo ahead for some time. Remco Evenepoel was briefly distanced after an acceleration but managed to return. On the climb at the start of the final lap, Paul Seixas attacked, with only Isaac del Toro able to follow. Del Toro launched the two-man sprint early and won convincingly.
